caption: The drawing depicts a single standing human figure, dressed in a colorful and ornate costume. The figure is wearing a red draped shawl over the shoulders that extends down to the hips, beneath which a blue and yellow-green tunic with a patterned hem is visible. The lower legs are covered by brown leg coverings, and brown shoes are worn on the feet. The figure stands on a rectangular green base. The head is adorned with a decorative headdress in shades of blue, white, and gold, featuring a central vertical feather or plume. Around the neck, the figure wears a yellow necklace with a circular medallion. The figure's right hand (left as viewed) is relaxed and the left hand (right as viewed) is bent at the elbow, holding part of the red shawl. The face is painted in natural tones with detailed features and the figure appears to be male. The background is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects or scenery. The name "Frank W. Gutting" is written at the bottom right of the image.
